title: Team Travis poised to deliver after Hurricane Michael
description: Airmen from the 21st Airlift Squadron and the 860th Aircraft Maintenance Squadron depart Travis AFB, California, in two C-17 Globermaster IIIs for Davis-Monthan AFB, Arizona, Oct. 10, 2018. The Airmen were postured to deliver search and rescue helicopters to aid hurricane relief efforts.
keywords: florence, Travis, Arizona, relief, Davis-Monthan AFB, 860th Aircraft Maintenance Squadron, flying crew chief, 21st Airlift Squadron, 21 AS, 860 AMXS, search and rescue, California, C-17 Globemaster III, Hurricane, Travis Air Force Base

transcript.text: - The feeling of just being able to help is amazing.
It's part of the reason why I joined this job,
is to travel and help people.
I was part of a hurricane a week before.
When you bring a team in with water, food,
and help to somebody that's been devastated,
- This really reminds me that our job in the Air Force
is not only to defend and support the Constitution
but really just to help America and Americans.
For the US Air Force, we have such a strong system
and processes in place, but really,
we do this kind of thing every day around the world.
I think times like this is when the American people
see this, how strong, and this global reach,
and global power that we have.
